name: av_live_two_unknowns
source:
{ Two live accessor constraints, two unknowns: a 2x2 Newton block whose every
  residual evaluation costs a full integration. }
kk = 0.01 + dk
Tsink = 10 + ds

FinalValue('Temp') = 55
ODEValue('Temp', 0.5) = 70

DYNAMIC cooling (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 1, points = 3)
  der(Temp) = -kk*(Temp - Tsink)
  Temp(0) = 100
END
